venture.name: Demo Demand Lab
venture.thesis: An autonomous agent tests narrow B2B demand by launching measurable customer-discovery campaigns for overlooked service niches.

milestone_contract.baseline: Zero qualified customer conversations and zero paid pilot commitments at the start of the proof window.
milestone_contract.outcome: Complete 20 qualified customer conversations and obtain at least two written paid-pilot commitments within 21 days.
milestone_contract.evidence_source: Timestamped CRM exports plus redacted written pilot commitments stored in a controller-approved evidence folder.
milestone_contract.permitted_use: Purchase approved prospect data, email infrastructure, and limited API credits required to run and measure the campaign.
